entries.0e2d6179330e9dd6: This business mainly carries out maintenance of vehicles sold, including vehicle inspections, maintenance servicing and sheet metal repairs. Through regular contact and periodic inspections after sale, it maintains relationships with customers and raises the rate of vehicles brought in for inspection to boost maintenance revenue.
entries.13fc35eb71633764: This business operates stores centred on “comprehensive stores,” which offer one-stop service from vehicle sales through maintenance to purchase, as well as the SUV specialist store “SUV LAND” and the large used imported car specialist store “UNIVERSE.”
entries.1d034f25f166c042: This is a coating business carried out mainly on vehicles sold by the group, operated by the consolidated subsidiary ASAP Co., Ltd. It uses an independently developed coating liquid specialising in water repellency, forming a glass film on the body surface.
entries.3095510a6314fc54: This business acquires vehicles through trade-ins at the time of vehicle sales and purchases brought in by customers, as well as visiting purchases where staff go to customers' homes. As of November 30, 2025, there were 65 purchase-only stores.
entries.4110babcd2adea5f: A business that operates authorized dealerships of imported car brands.
entries.41ce1acceaba20a4: This business acts as an agency for non-life insurance companies, acquiring new automobile insurance policies at the time of vehicle sales. It builds post-sale support systems to improve insurance renewal rates and deepen ties with customers.
entries.628632d0fcd3c917: It is the Group's only business (a single segment), centered on sales of used and new cars and covering maintenance, insurance agency and vehicle purchasing.
